title: Equivariant naturality of framed relative torsor classes
statement: Use the raw lifting classification relativeTorsorEquiv of [lem-amb-relative-cocycle-coordinates]. For a coefficient morphism f:G→G′ on T and an augmentation-preserving morphism of injective resolutions I→J, every natural f-equivariant map P→Q of torsors takes a specified section over an etale U to a section whose relative class is the image of the class of (P,s). More generally, for h:T′→T, an open W⊂T, a coefficient map f:G→h_*G′, an augmentation-preserving map I→h_*J and an f-equivariant natural map P→(h^et)^*Q on underlying site presheaves, the corresponding map of the actual restriction cones [def-weil-pbc-etale-resolution-section-transfer] carries the raw class of (P,s) to the raw class of Q with section obtained from s by that map and the canonical open pullback. The conclusion holds for any commuting restriction square of these resolution maps.

proof.text: Choose lifting presentations for P and Q using the first rows of I and J. Their maps into I⁰ and J⁰ are equivariant for the two augmentation maps, and applying the first differential gives the respective global cycles coordinates.

proof.text: For a coefficient morphism, compare the source presentation followed by the degree-zero resolution map with the target presentation preceded by the given torsor map. Augmentation compatibility gives identical G-equivariance. The invariant-difference descent of [lem-amb-framed-lifts-classification] supplies x∈J⁰(T). Its differential is the difference of global cycles coordinates, and its restriction to U is the difference of the pointed coordinates. Apply relativeFrameClass_map_eq.

source.place: Tag 03AJ, lemma-torsors-h1; agent-written relative lifting-torsor refinement of its injective-resolution argument.

proof.text: For scheme pullback, make the same comparison in the direct-image sheaves h_*J⁰ and h_*J¹ on T. Invariant-difference descent again gives a global x. Pull this section along the terminal pullback morphism to a section x′ of J⁰ on T′. Naturality of terminal and open pullback maps identifies its differential and open restriction with the two differences in the target cone. Apply relativeFrameClass_map_eq. No injectivity of h_*J is required here, since the target lifting presentation is made on T′ before direct image.

theorem relativeTorsorEquiv_transfer
    {T T' : Scheme.{u}} (h : T' ⟶ T) (W : T.Opens)
    {G : Sheaf T.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}}
    {G' : Sheaf T'.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}}
    (f : G ⟶ (lowerStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} h).obj G')
    (I : InjectiveResolution G) (J : InjectiveResolution G')
    (a : I.cocomplex ⟶
      ((lowerStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} h).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℕ)).obj J.cocomplex)
    (ha : I.ι.f 0 ≫ a.f 0 = f ≫ (lowerStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} h).map (J.ι.f 0))
    (P : Sheaf.Torsor.WithSection G (Scheme.Etale.mk W.ι)) (Q : Sheaf.Torsor G')
    (b : P.1.sheaf.obj ⟶ (MorphismProperty.Over.pullback @Etale ⊤ h).op ⋙ Q.sheaf.obj)
    (hb : ∀ A g t, b.app A (P.1.vadd A g t) =
      Q.vadd (op ((MorphismProperty.Over.pullback @Etale ⊤ h).obj A.unop))
        (f.hom.app A g) (b.app A t))
    (hsquare : HomologicalComplex.extendMap
        (globalResolutionSectionTransfer h I.cocomplex J.cocomplex a)
        ComplexShape.embeddingUpNat ≫
        relativeSectionRestriction T' (Scheme.Etale.mk (h ⁻¹ᵁ W).ι) J.cocomplex =
      relativeSectionRestriction T (Scheme.Etale.mk W.ι) I.cocomplex ≫
        HomologicalComplex.extendMap
          (openResolutionSectionTransfer h I.cocomplex J.cocomplex a W)
          ComplexShape.embeddingUpNat) :
    HomologicalComplex.homologyMap (relativeFiberMap _ _
        (HomologicalComplex.extendMap
          (globalResolutionSectionTransfer h I.cocomplex J.cocomplex a)
          ComplexShape.embeddingUpNat)
        (HomologicalComplex.extendMap
          (openResolutionSectionTransfer h I.cocomplex J.cocomplex a W)
          ComplexShape.embeddingUpNat) hsquare) 1
        (relativeTorsorEquiv T (Scheme.Etale.mk W.ι) I (Quotient.mk _ P)) =
      relativeTorsorEquiv T' (Scheme.Etale.mk (h ⁻¹ᵁ W).ι) J (Quotient.mk _
        ⟨Q, Q.sheaf.obj.map (openSectionPullback h W).op
          (b.app (op (Scheme.Etale.mk W.ι)) P.2)⟩)
